brief: Name the invented building society Kieran works for: a mutual savings and mortgage society founded in Swindon in the nineteenth century by railway workers pooling savings to buy houses, now a mid-sized society with its head office and payments operations in west Swindon. It stands in for the real mutuals of the town and must not resemble any real society's name.
context: British English; Swindon, Wiltshire. Existing names: Kieran Hale, Barbara Ashby, Laura Russell, Faye Titcombe (author persona). Real building societies must not be named or imitated.
constraints: Sounds like a real British building society name of the Victorian mutual tradition
Must not match or closely resemble an existing building society
Short enough for a lanyard and a letterhead
